property_summary: After any successful call to SetMinSum, the internal reentrancy lock is released (locked_ = false), permitting a subsequent call to a nonReentrant function (like Initialized) to succeed; the bug leaves the lock permanently set (locked_ = true), causing any subsequent nonReentrant function call to revert.
change_summary: Change `locked_ = false;` to `locked_ = true;` so the lock stays set forever, preventing any further calls to SetMinSum after the first.
